name: VIA Agent OS TokenEngine

source.provenance: Existing sandbox hardened derivative; does not prove Tony-NB local copy or GitHub equality

description: VCGC additive candidate: preserve prior VCGC provisioning/installation/governance tools, add local TokenEngine and VIA System Atlas. Not replacement; no existing VCGC engine was modified.

parameters.name: context.text
parameters.notes: Prepared in memory; no raw-source persistence

parameters.name: --query
parameters.notes: Activates selection only together with --allow-lossy and when input is not compactable JSON

parameters.name: --allow-lossy
parameters.notes: Explicit permission for lossy query-line extraction

parameters.name: --max-lines
parameters.notes: Caps extracted source lines; hard maximum 400

parameters.name: --include-text
parameters.notes: If omitted, emits metadata without prepared_text

parameters.name: prepared_text
parameters.notes: JSON compact preserves JSON semantics; query extraction is lossy and adds source line numbers

parameters.name: chars_before / chars_after
parameters.notes: Measured on redacted source and prepared output

parameters.name: tokens_before_est / tokens_after_est / estimated_savings_percent
parameters.notes: ASCII ceil(chars/4); configured CJK codepoints 1.5 each, other codepoints 0.25 each, rounded up; not tokenizer billing

parameters.name: source_hash
parameters.notes: Hash of redacted source; common-pattern redaction is not a complete secret scanner

parameters.name: skills run JSON stdin
parameters.notes: No recursive Skills or agent spawning

parameters.name: 8 Skills acceptance
parameters.notes: Acceptance results are not remote integration tests

parameters.name: scan --root
parameters.notes: Never imports or executes scanned source

parameters.name: AST inventory
parameters.notes: Optional --out creates a new report outside scanned root

parameters.name: record_provider_usage(provider, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens)
parameters.notes: Does not call provider; caller is responsible for persistence/retention

commands.name: context
commands.purpose: redact common secrets; compact valid JSON losslessly; optional lossy query lines

commands.name: skills test
commands.purpose: run deterministic acceptance suite for eight Skills

commands.name: skills run
commands.purpose: execute one local deterministic Skill with JSON stdin

commands.name: scan
commands.purpose: bounded read-only Python AST inventory; never import/execute
